agent_spawn.reason: Subagent fan-out burns the usage window (Tito, 2026-10-06). Do the item yourself, serially, or ask Tito first. This guard allows it only when his latest message asks for agents, parallel work or a workflow.

pkill_f.reason: `pkill -f` and `pgrep -f` inside a Bash call match their own command line and kill your own shell. Take a pid from `ps` and kill that, or use the [x] trick in the pattern (for example `pgrep -f '[b]acklog_worker'`).
